itens.titulo: AI Price Prediction: ChatGPT Predicts Where Ethereum, Chainlink and Uniswap Could Be by the End of 2026
itens.descricao: AI Price Prediction: ChatGPT Predicts Where Ethereum, Chainlink and Uniswap Could Be by the End of 2026 Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - CME Group listed UNI futures on October 19, 2026, yet UNI still dropped 5% that same week despite the new institutional access.
- Spot Ether ETFs shed $225 million in the week of October 19, pulling cumulative net inflows down to $12.71 billion from $13.96 billion.
- ChatGPT assigns UNI a 45% chance of leading the three coins, with a bull case target of $12 representing a 71% gain from current prices.
ChatGPT's AI price prediction indicates that by December 31, 2026, Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) could be priced at $2,650, Chainlink (CRYPTO: LINK) at $13.50, and Uniswap (CRYPTO: UNI) at $8.50.
These targets are based on starting prices of $2,329 for ETH, $11.44 for LINK, and $7.01 for UNI, all slightly above their current trading levels.
As of October 26, ETH trades at $2,301, down 13.2% this month and 53.3% from its all-time high.
LINK has fallen to $11.39, down 19.8% over the past 30 days, while UNI is down to $6.96, a 27.2% drop in the same timeframe.
In terms of potential, ChatGPT sees UNI with a 45% chance of showing the largest gains among the three, followed by LINK at 35%, and ETH at 20%.

itens.titulo: Açúcar cai 5,63% em Nova York sob influência do câmbio e safra brasileira
itens.descricao: Açúcar cai 5,63% em Nova York sob influência do câmbio e safra brasileira CNN Brasil
trechos: O contrato futuro do açúcar com vencimento em março recuou 5,63% na Bolsa de Nova York e encerrou a sessão cotado a 19,10 centavos de dólar por libra-peso.
Segundo análise do Barchart, a forte queda foi influenciada pela desvalorização de cerca de 9% do real brasileiro após o resultado das eleições presidenciais no fim de semana.

Por outro lado, dados da Unica (União da Indústria de Cana-de-Açúcar e Bioenergia), divulgados na sexta-feira anterior, mostraram que a produção de açúcar na região Centro-Sul do Brasil caiu 5,6% em agosto na comparação anual, para 7,089 milhões de toneladas.
Cacau O contrato futuro do cacau com vencimento em dezembro encerrou a sessão na Bolsa de Nova York em queda de 1,82%, cotado a US$ 5.490 por tonelada.
Segundo análise do Barchart, as cotações foram pressionadas pela desvalorização de cerca de 9% do real brasileiro após o resultado das eleições presidenciais no fim de semana.
Os volumes vêm crescendo desde o início do ano e chegaram a 3.684.698 sacas na segunda-feira, o maior nível em dois anos e meio, de acordo com o Barchart.
Café Na Bolsa de Nova York, o contrato futuro do café com vencimento em dezembro recuou 2,11% e encerrou a sessão cotado a US$ 3,00 por libra-peso.

Segundo análise do Barchart, a queda foi influenciada pela desvalorização do real brasileiro, que recuou cerca de 9% após a vitória de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva nas eleições presidenciais realizadas no fim de semana, conforme o relato da plataforma.

itens.titulo: Alphabet Stocks Move Lower Before Cloud Margin Test
itens.descricao: Alphabet Stocks Move Lower Before Cloud Margin Test Yahoo Finance
trechos: Alphabet, Google's search, advertising and cloud parent (GOOGL), traded at $315.74, down approximately 0.5%, at 9:55 a.m.
Alphabet reported second-quarter cloud operating income of $8.8 billion on revenue of $24.8 billion, implying a margin of roughly 35.6%.
Cloud revenue surged 82%, outpacing the company's overall revenue growth of 24% to $119.8 billion.
The valuation leaves less room for disappointment: the shares sit 22.79% above the displayed GF Value estimate of $257.14.

itens.titulo: Alphabet (GOOG) Could Be a Key Rival to Meta in the Race for AI Assistants, Burke Wealth Says
itens.descricao: Alphabet (GOOG) Could Be a Key Rival to Meta in the Race for AI Assistants, Burke Wealth Says Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Burke Wealth Management, an investment management company, released its "Focused Growth Strategy" Q3 2026 investor letter.
The fund delivered strong results in the third quarter of 2026, benefiting from a sharp recovery in enterprise software and solid corporate earnings amid continued market volatility.
The composite returned 10.8% net of fees, substantially outperforming the S&P 500 Total Return Index's 2.3% gain, while its year-to-date return reached 20.0%, compared with 12.7% for the benchmark.

Burke believes these platforms can serve as essential AI "harnesses," providing permissions, security, and context for enterprise applications, although it cautions that AI agents could challenge traditional software business models and seat-based pricing.

Looking ahead, Burke remains optimistic about the remainder of 2026, citing strong corporate earnings growth and the transition from AI infrastructure investment toward practical applications that may improve productivity and consumer experiences.
In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.
In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Burke Wealth Focused Growth Strategy highlighted stocks like Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG).
The one-month return of Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) was -6.99% while its shares traded between $264.94 and $404.47 over the last 52 weeks.
